CAMP/dbAMP rows use generic PMAP-36 labels and some text includes targets outside this paper; source-supported Table 2-4 values are retained separately while conflicts remain explicit.
DBAASP RI12 rows omit some source MIC rows, especially footnote-c bacterial MICs, although present values match primary tables.
PMC XML metadata reports no supplement; local supplementary landing files are publisher article pages or unrelated reference material, and no supplementary data table was found.

summary: Source-reviewed worker-4/worker-6 rework closed the framework-test ticket.
